gen-unbounded-gf-esteban: Esteban's lowercase looks oversized beside its capitals, with thin strokes barely slimmer than the stems, and Unbounded stretches out above it. Unbounded's low-contrast, friendly lettering gives the soft-pencil modulation room to speak.
gen-unbounded-gf-faustina: Friendly, wide-set Unbounded has a broad-mouthed c, while Faustina's bowls thin gracefully without turning sharp. Yet the real draw is low-contrast display letters set against a serif with a modest stroke rhythm.
gen-unbounded-gf-halant: Authoritative from the first line, Halant is a text serif whose terminals point outward like tongs and whose x-height towers. Unbounded's rounder, friendlier lettering loosens the mood without crowding it.
gen-unbounded-gf-hedvig-letters-serif: Hedvig Letters Serif gives lowercase a tall, sturdy body, with open-ended curves and contrast pitched halfway between monoline and sharp. Unbounded is best at a friendly, wide welcome; Hedvig at carrying the words.
gen-unbounded-gf-lisu-bosa: Lisu Bosa gives words a sturdy, tall look, with counters that spill into the space around them. Next to Unbounded's wide, friendly lettering, it feels grounded and a bit editorial.
gen-unbounded-gf-marcellus-sc: Dignified Marcellus SC pulls its terminals well back, while Unbounded stretches out in friendly, low-contrast shapes. Marcellus SC carries lowercase with the stature of cast iron capitals, and that is the standout quality.
gen-unbounded-gf-montagu-slab: Montagu Slab brings robust downstrokes and slender turns in comfortable contrast. Unbounded's low-contrast, friendly heading sits close in stroke feel to that serif, so the move from title to text feels like a small step.
gen-unbounded-gf-noto-serif-hentaigana: Wide and friendly up top, Unbounded hands off to something refined. Down the page, Noto Serif Hentaigana keeps reading smooth, its curves open-jawed and its strokes lightly modulated, with no harsh thin spots.
gen-unbounded-gf-ovo: Classic, measured contrast, like thread against yarn, sits beneath the friendly, wide-set Unbounded. Ovo keeps a tall middle band and spacious curve terminals, so paragraphs of text move along smoothly.
gen-vast-shadow-fs-literata: Vast Shadow is vintage and eye-catching, with a tall mean line and generous space on either side. Literata, with its mild stroke variation and open curves, is the bookish counterweight that makes the whole thing work.
